# Support

- **Using CoreTend:** the [support page](https://coretend.ahmetbsbnr.com/en/support) answers the usual
  questions (first launch, folder access, getting a file back from the Trash, removing CoreTend).
- **A bug:** open an issue with a template from `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`. Include your CoreTend
  version, macOS version and Mac model, what you did and what you saw. Leave out personal file
  names and paths.
- **A security problem:** do not open a public issue; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **An idea:** use the feature-request template.
